# Loading Libraries and Data
```{r message=FALSE}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(limma)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# Load the SKCM data
data <- load("SKCM.rda")
```

```{r}
# Extract clinical data
clinical <- colData(query2) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, gender, vital_status, days_to_death, 
               ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis)

# Create proper survival object
clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = days_to_death / 365,
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age__diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  )
```

```{r}
counts <- assay(query2)                # Gene expression counts
genes  <- rowData(query2)              # Gene info
samples <- colData(query2)             # Clinical/sample metadata
```



# Checking Missing Values and Variable Types
```{r}
# Examine clinical data for missing values
missing_clinical <- colSums(is.na(clinical))
print(paste("Missing values in clinical data:", missing_clinical))

# Check variable types in clinical data
str(clinical)

# Calculate basic statistics for expression data 
fpkm <- assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand")

# Check missing values in expression data
missing_expr <- sum(is.na(fpkm))
print(paste("Missing values in expression data:", missing_expr))

# Check distribution of categorical variables
cat("\nDistribution of categorical variables:\n")
print(table(clinical$gender, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(clinical$vital_status, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage, useNA = "ifany"))
```


# Distribution of Median Gene Expression
```{r}
# Get median expression per gene
median_expr <- rowMedians(fpkm)
hist(log2(median_expr + 1), main="Distribution of Median Gene Expression", 
     xlab="log2(FPKM + 1)")
```



# Melonoma Genes Expression Analysis
```{r}
# Get top 10 most highly expressed genes
top_10_genes <- order(median_expr, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
top_10_ids <- rowData(query2)$gene_id[top_10_genes]
top_10_names <- rowData(query2)$gene_name[top_10_genes]

# Create a data frame with both name and ID
top_genes_df <- data.frame(
  Rank = 1:10,
  Gene_Name = top_10_names,
  Ensembl_ID = top_10_ids
)

# Display the table
print(top_genes_df)

# Extract expression for top genes
top_expr <- log2(fpkm[top_10_genes, ] + 1)
rownames(top_expr) <- top_10_names

# Create boxplots of expression by stage
top_expr_df <- as.data.frame(t(top_expr))
top_expr_df$stage <- colData(query2)$ajcc_pathologic_stage

# Reshape for ggplot
library(reshape2)
top_expr_long <- melt(top_expr_df, id.vars = "stage", 
                     variable.name = "gene", value.name = "expression")

# Plot
ggplot(na.omit(top_expr_long), aes(x = gene, y = expression, fill = stage)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Expression of Top 10 Genes by Stage", 
       y = "log2(FPKM + 1)", x = "Gene")

# Print the names of the top 10 genes
cat("Top 10 expressed genes:", paste(top_10_names, collapse=", "))
```

# Other EDA with age and gender

## Age Distribution
```{r}
# Basic data structure exploration
dim(query2)  # Get dimensions (genes × samples)
summary(colData(query2))  # Summary of sample metadata
table(colData(query2)$vital_status)  # Count of alive vs deceased patients
table(colData(query2)$gender)  # Distribution by gender
hist(colData(query2)$days_to_birth/-365, main="Age Distribution", xlab="Age (years)")
```

## Age vs Cancer Stage
```{r}
# Create boxplot of age vs cancer stage
ggplot(na.omit(clinical), 
       aes(x = ajcc_pathologic_stage, y = age__diagnosis, fill = ajcc_pathologic_stage)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution by Cancer Stage", 
       x = "AJCC Pathologic Stage", 
       y = "Age at Diagnosis (years)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
# Statistical test for age differences between stages
age_stage_test <- aov(age__diagnosis ~ ajcc_pathologic_stage, data = clinical)
print(summary(age_stage_test))
# Mean age by stage
clinical %>%
  group_by(ajcc_pathologic_stage) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean_age = mean(age__diagnosis, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age__diagnosis, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(ajcc_pathologic_stage) %>%
  print()
```

# PCAs
```{r}
complete_cases <- complete.cases(clinical$vital_status, clinical$survival_time)

# Filter log expression and clinical data
log_expr_complete <- log2(fpkm[, complete_cases] + 1)
top_var_genes <- order(rowVars(log_expr_complete), decreasing = TRUE)[1:1000]

# PCA on selected top variable genes
pca_result <- prcomp(t(log_expr_complete[top_var_genes, ]), scale. = TRUE)

# Make sure survival_bin is already in clinical
clinical$survival_time <- as.numeric(as.character(clinical$survival_time))
clinical$survival_bin <- cut(
  clinical$survival_time,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 1, 3, Inf),
  labels = c("<1 year", "1-3 years", ">3 years")
)

# Create PCA dataframe
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_result$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_result$x[, 2],
  PC3 = pca_result$x[, 3],
  PC4 = pca_result$x[, 4],
  age = clinical$age__diagnosis[complete_cases],
  gender = clinical$gender[complete_cases],
  survival = clinical$survival_time[complete_cases],
  survival_bin = clinical$survival_bin[complete_cases]
)


# Plot PCA colored by stage
ggplot(na.omit(pca_df), aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = survival)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "PCA of Survival", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_minimal()

# PCA by age groups
pca_df$age_group <- cut(pca_df$age, 
                        breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), 
                        labels = c("<25", "25-50", "50-75", ">75"))
ggplot(na.omit(pca_df), aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = age_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "PCA of Age", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## PC1 vs PC2
```{r}
# Define survival threshold (e.g., median split)
surv_median <- median(clinical$survival_time, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add survival group to clinical data
clinical$survival_group <- ifelse(clinical$survival_time > surv_median, "High", "Low")

# Match clinical to PCA samples
pca_df$survival_group <- clinical$survival_group[match(rownames(pca_df), rownames(clinical))]

# Plot PCA colored by survival group
ggplot(na.omit(pca_df), aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = survival_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "PCA of SKCM Samples by Survival Group", 
       x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "Survival Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("High" = "#1f78b4", "Low" = "#e31a1c"))
```

```{r}
# Define survival quantiles (3 bins: Tertiles)
surv_tertiles <- quantile(clinical$survival_time, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

# Add survival group based on tertiles
clinical$survival_group <- cut(clinical$survival_time, 
                               breaks = surv_tertiles, 
                               include.lowest = TRUE, 
                               labels = c("T1 (Low)", "T2", "T3 (High)"))

# Match clinical to PCA samples
pca_df$survival_group <- clinical$survival_group[match(rownames(pca_df), rownames(clinical))]

# Plot PCA colored by survival group (tertiles)
```

## Survival plots

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Create survival object
surv_obj <- Surv(clinical$survival_time, clinical$event)
# Kaplan-Meier survival curve by gender
fit_gender <- survfit(surv_obj ~ gender, data = clinical)
# Log-rank test
log_rank <- survdiff(surv_obj ~ gender, data = clinical)
print(log_rank)
# Create survival plot
ggsurvplot(fit_gender, 
           data = clinical, 
           pval = TRUE,
           conf.int = TRUE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           risk.table.col = "strata",
           linetype = "strata",
           surv.median.line = "hv",
           ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
           palette = c("#E7B800", "#2E9FDF"),
           title = "Kaplan-Meier Curve by Gender")

# Cox proportional hazards model
cox_gender <- coxph(surv_obj ~ gender, data = clinical)
print(summary(cox_gender))
```

```{r}
clinical$age_group <- cut(
  clinical$age__diagnosis,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 40, 60, Inf),
  labels = c("<40", "40-60", ">60")
)

fit_age <- survfit(surv_obj ~ age_group, data = clinical)
ggsurvplot(fit_age,
           data = clinical,
           pval = TRUE,
           conf.int = TRUE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           palette = "Dark2",
           ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
           title = "Kaplan-Meier Curve by Age Group")

# Cox proportional hazards model
cox_age <- coxph(surv_obj ~ age_group, data = clinical)
print(summary(cox_age))
```

```{r}
fit_stage <- survfit(surv_obj ~ ajcc_pathologic_stage, data = clinical)

# Plot

)

# Cox proportional hazards model

print(summary(cox_stage))
```



# Candidate Genes for Modelling
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. Select complete cases for survival analysis
log_expr <- log2(fpkm + 1)
complete_cases <- complete.cases(clinical$event, clinical$survival_time)
clinical_complete <- clinical[complete_cases,]
expr_complete <- log_expr[, complete_cases]
# 2. Perform univariate Cox regression for each gene
gene_cox_results <- data.frame(
  gene_id = character(),
  gene_name = character(),
  coef = numeric(),
  hazard_ratio = numeric(),
  pvalue = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
gene_subset <- sample(1:nrow(expr_complete), 1000)  # Random 1000 genes
for (i in gene_subset) {
  gene_expr <- expr_complete[i,]
  gene_id <- rowData(query2)$gene_id[i]
  gene_name <- rowData(query2)$gene_name[i]
  
  tryCatch({
    cox_model <- coxph(Surv(clinical_complete$survival_time, clinical_complete$event) ~ gene_expr)
    coef <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients[1]
    hazard_ratio <- exp(coef)
    pvalue <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients[5]
    
    gene_cox_results <- rbind(gene_cox_results, data.frame(
      gene_id = gene_id,
      gene_name = gene_name,
      coef = coef,
      hazard_ratio = hazard_ratio,
      pvalue = pvalue
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Skip genes with errors
  })
}
# 3. Apply multiple testing correction
gene_cox_results$fdr <- p.adjust(gene_cox_results$pvalue, method = "BH")
# 4. Select significant genes
significant_genes <- gene_cox_results %>%
  filter(fdr < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(fdr)
# 5. Visualize hazard ratios for top genes
top_cox_genes <- gene_cox_results %>%
  arrange(pvalue) %>%
  head(20)
ggplot(top_cox_genes, aes(x = reorder(gene_name, hazard_ratio), 
                         y = hazard_ratio, fill = pvalue < 0.05)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey", "red"), 
                    name = "Significant (p<0.05)") +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Genes Associated with Survival",
       x = "Gene", 
       y = "Hazard Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed")
# 6. Get expression patterns of top survival genes
top_genes_expr <- expr_complete[rowData(query2)$gene_id %in% top_cox_genes$gene_id[1:5], ]
rownames(top_genes_expr) <- top_cox_genes$gene_name[1:5]
# Create boxplots by survival status
top_genes_long <- melt(t(top_genes_expr), 
                       varnames = c("Sample", "Gene"), 
                       value.name = "Expression")
top_genes_long$Status <- factor(clinical_complete$vital_status[top_genes_long$Sample], 
                               levels = c("Dead", "Alive"))
ggplot(top_genes_long, aes(x = Gene, y = Expression, fill = Status)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Expression of Top Survival Genes by Vital Status",
       x = "Gene", 
       y = "log2(FPKM + 1)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
